## Improvements

- Measure tokens per second and first-token latency for direct and nested subagents using the same request boundaries as the main agent.
- Show the selected subagent's latest measured performance in the sidebar and include child measurements in model-picker statistics.
- Persist measured child requests in a bounded local journal, independent of UI polling and main-agent history writes.
- Require the updated maintained subagent package (0.5.29) for child measurements. Existing agents need to restart before they report new metrics.

This supersedes the unpublished v1.2.15 tag and corrects the package-version readiness regression fixture.
